system.description:
Favoured weapon: Club

Granted power: While you stand on natural stone or earth, you can't be pushed or knocked Prone against your will.

  • When your Smite hits, the ground within 20ft of you becomes difficult terrain for your enemies until your next turn. 9th level: the ground reaches 40ft, and an enemy in it can't take the Disengage action.
  • Both last until the start of your next turn.

Allegiance: True Neutral, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Grumbar in the World of Arneyan wiki.

Suggested vow: raise or guard one thing meant to outlast you (your god's Paladin oath on the wiki; the vow you swear is yours to choose).
